Body.Content:
Outlook will remember whether your online archive is expanded or collapsed when you return. Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows will each keep their own saved state. This saves you from repeatedly expanding or collapsing your archive as you navigate your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

GA date: February CY2027
